name: recall
changes: 다중 세션 검색과 특정 대화 검색의 입력·페이지·서비스 범위를 실제 native 계약에 맞춘다. 저렴한 병렬 기록 조사, 수정 시각 정렬, 노이즈 제외와 사용자 역할 설정 우선순위를 보존한다.
equivalence: 6단계와 기본 7일 범위, all을 임의로 최근 N개로 바꾸지 않기, 1~2개 대화면 직접 조사, 현재 대화·자식·시험 노이즈 제외, 대상이 있는 경우 why 공유 기록 조사 필수, 실시간 PR/브랜치 확인, Capsule/Threads/Problems/Next move 형식을 보존. 기록 위치와 병렬 호출 2구간만 native 형식으로 변경. 저렴한 workflow 기본값보다 저장한 역할 설정이 우선하며, 예산·속도 정책도 실제 호출에 적용한다.
checks: exact reviewed replacements; all other bytes preserved

rewrites.before: Transcripts live at `~/.cursor/projects/<slug>/agent-transcripts/<uuid>/<uuid>.jsonl`, where `<slug>` is the workspace path with the leading slash dropped and each "/" turned into "-" (so `/Users/you/proj` becomes `Users-you-proj`). Every line is one chat message.
rewrites.after: Full OpenCode messages are available through `pstack_history`, including before compaction. `current` identifies this chat. `search` requires `query`; without `sessionID` it searches all sessions in the selected scope, while adding `sessionID` narrows it to one chat. For example, `pstack_history(action: "search", query: "compaction", limit: 20)` searches this workspace; add `repositoryHistory: true` only for an authorized repository-wide search, including retired worktrees. `list` returns session metadata. `read` and `export` require `sessionID`. Search results contain `matches` with session IDs and full matching messages; `limit` caps matches, not scanned messages. Keep following the returned cursor with the same query and scope even if a page has no matches, until `complete: true`. Cursors expire after one hour. These operations read only the current OpenCode service/database, not every profile's database. An empty completed search is not proof that older chats in another database do not exist. Use another `workspace` only when the user explicitly named it.
rewrites.reason: 다중 세션 검색과 특정 대화 검색의 입력·페이지·서비스 범위를 실제 native 계약에 맞춘다.

rewrites.before: 3. Fan out across your chat history. Spawn parallel subagents on a fast, cheap model, each taking a slice of the corpus. Tell every subagent to order candidates by real modification time (`ls -t`) and never by UUID name, grep the topic first and then read only the matching chats and only their relevant regions, and skip the current chat plus obvious noise (subagent, eval, and test chats). Each returns the same schema, one block per chat: topic, the user's goal, decisions, open threads, struggles and corrections, and artifacts (PRs, tickets, branches), each citing the chat UUID. For one or two chats, skip the fan-out and search directly. The raw transcripts stay in the subagents. The main thread gets only their findings. Pick each subagent's reasoning level and fast or standard speed for the job, per the Subagents section of the **poteto-mode** skill.
rewrites.after: 3. Fan out across your chat history. Spawn parallel native `subagent` calls with `agent: "general", role: "how explorer", background: true`, each taking a corpus slice. Preserve the fast, cheap model preference: inspect saved roles first; if the user has not overridden this role, select an advertised low-cost model with `opencode_models` and pass its native ID as `defaultModel`. A saved role override always wins over this workflow default. Do not invent availability or prices. Tell every subagent to order candidates by real native `time.updated` values, collecting and sorting the scoped pages and never by UUID name, use `pstack_history(action: "search", sessionID: <assigned chat ID>, query: ...)` for the topic first, following cursors even on empty scan pages and then read only the matching chats and only their relevant regions, and skip the current chat plus obvious noise (subagent, eval, and test chats). Each returns the same schema, one block per chat: topic, the user's goal, decisions, open threads, struggles and corrections, and artifacts (PRs, tickets, branches), each citing the chat UUID. For one or two chats, skip the fan-out and search directly. The raw transcripts stay in the subagents. The main thread gets only their findings. Use `difficulty: "routine"` for this mining work and choose `urgent` per **poteto-mode**; the native executor applies the reasoning budget and speed policy. A cheap model need not use a paid fast-speed mode.
